entries.title: Attention Is All You Need
entries.summary: Introduces the attention-based Transformer. A starting point for understanding the architecture behind modern language models.

entries.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
entries.summary: Combines a language model with retrieved documents. Useful grounding for systems that need external knowledge and traceable evidence.

entries.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
entries.summary: Interleaves reasoning and actions, letting observations influence the next step. A central reference for tool-using agent loops.

entries.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
entries.summary: Adapts a frozen model using small trainable low-rank updates. A practical foundation for customizing models with fewer trainable parameters.

entries.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
entries.summary: Explores how worked reasoning examples affect language-model performance on multi-step tasks. A useful reference for the evolution of reasoning methods.

entries.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
entries.summary: Connects demonstrations, preference judgments, and reinforcement learning to instruction following. A key reference for post-training assistants.

entries.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
entries.summary: Derives a direct objective for learning from preference pairs, offering an alternative to a separate reward-model and RL training loop.

entries.title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
entries.summary: Turns real repository issues into a software-engineering benchmark. Useful for thinking about executable checks and realistic agent evaluation.

entries.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
entries.summary: Explores reinforcement learning for reasoning and distillation into smaller models. A reference for how reasoning behavior can develop during post-training.

entries.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
entries.summary: Examines task performance from examples in the prompt without parameter updates. A landmark for scaling and in-context learning.

entries.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
entries.summary: Builds bidirectional language representations that transfer to downstream tasks. Helpful background for language understanding and model adaptation.

entries.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
entries.summary: Learns shared image-text representations from paired data. A foundation for zero-shot visual recognition and multimodal retrieval.

entries.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
entries.summary: Studies image generation through an iterative denoising process. A foundational reading for diffusion-based generative models.

entries.title: Harness-Zero: Harness Distillation via Agent-as-Harness
entries.summary: Investigates transferring behavior induced by specialized agent infrastructure into model weights. New preprint; the reported gains need independent scrutiny.

entries.title: Emergent Collusion in Long-Horizon LLM Agent Interaction
entries.summary: Studies how repeated agent interactions and reward incentives can produce protocol violations. Relevant to designing independent verification and oversight.

entries.title: GRUET: Quantifying Uncertainty of Agentic Reasoning-and-Acting Processes
entries.summary: Models branching reasoning as a graph to estimate uncertainty across an agent trajectory. An emerging approach to assessing when an agent may be unreliable.

entries.title: Beyond Endpoint Performance: Process-Level Evaluation of Self-Evolving Agents
entries.summary: Introduces EvoPathBench to track how capabilities change as agent artifacts evolve. Looks beyond final scores to retention, transfer, and adaptation.

entries.title: Ascent: An Agentic System over the Model Context Protocol for Real-World Clinical Data Analysis
entries.summary: Uses a shared MCP interface for clinical data tools and compares agents with fixed pipelines. Useful reading on domain-specific tool design and accuracy-cost tradeoffs.

entries.title: Extremely Sparse Supervision Incentivizes Reasoning Ability
entries.summary: Investigates whether supervising a small fraction of tokens can improve reasoning during on-policy distillation. A recent hypothesis about more efficient post-training.

entries.title: From Symbolic Perception to Logical Deduction: A Framework for Guiding Language Models in Geometric Reasoning
entries.summary: Combines visual parsing with symbolic deduction for geometry problems. A concrete example of using specialized components alongside language models.

entries.title: The Illustrated Transformer
entries.summary: A visual companion to the Transformer paper, walking through attention, representations, and the encoder-decoder structure.

entries.title: Building effective agents
entries.summary: Practical patterns for choosing workflows, orchestration, and autonomous tool loops. Read as a design reference; tooling has evolved since publication.

entries.title: Effective context engineering for AI agents
entries.summary: Treats context as a limited resource. Covers selecting relevant information and managing agent state over longer tasks.
